findings.title: Feature-disabled exit-code contract is only partially tested
findings.body: The new testFeatureNotEnabled test covers only the metadata subcommand and asserts only the stderr text. It does not cover the check subcommand, which has its own new Profile.isFeatureEnabled branch in UpdateCompatibilityCheck.run(), and it does not assert exit code 4 (CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED) for either subcommand. The exit code is the documented scripting contract for this feature, so a regression that prints the message but exits 0, 1, or the old recreate code would pass this test while breaking automation that distinguishes feature-disabled (4) from recreate (3).

findings.title: Default update-strategy deployments do not enable rolling-updates in the CR
findings.body: createInitialDeployment returns immediately when updateStrategy is null, before setting FeatureSpec.enabledFeatures to rolling-updates, so both parameterized tests run their default-strategy cases without the feature enabled in the Keycloak CR. The operator guide added in this PR states the rolling-updates feature must be enabled for operator update handling and shows it alongside the update strategy, so the default path's CR-level feature propagation is left untested; these cases can only pass because the shared custom test image bakes --features=rolling-updates in at build time (operator/scripts/Dockerfile-custom-image), masking a regression for images that rely on the CR to enable the feature.
